description: This file contains a Node.js script that performs documentation link auditing within a project. It includes functions to walk the documentation directory, normalize routes, resolve redirects, collect navigation page entries, sanitize configuration, and run the link audit, including checking for broken internal links and navigation references.

methods.name: walk
methods.description: Recursively traverses a directory to list all files, skipping hidden files/directories.

methods.name: normalizeSlashes
methods.description: Converts Windows backslashes to forward slashes in file paths.

methods.name: normalizeRoute
methods.description: Normalizes a route string by removing query strings, hashes, and leading/trailing slashes.

methods.name: stripInlineCode
methods.description: Removes inline code snippets wrapped in backticks from text.

methods.name: resolveRoute
methods.description: Resolves a route by following redirects and checking if it is published.

methods.name: collectNavPageEntries
methods.description: Recursively collects page entries from navigation configuration.

methods.name: sanitizeDocsConfigForEnglishOnly
methods.description: Filters and sanitizes the documentation configuration to include only English content.

methods.name: prepareAnchorAuditDocsDir
methods.description: Prepares a temporary directory for anchor link auditing, sanitizing docs JSON.

methods.name: auditDocsLinks
methods.description: Performs link checking in documentation files, reporting broken or unresolved links.

methods.name: runDocsLinkAuditCli
methods.description: CLI entry point to run the documentation link audit, optionally checking anchors.
